videos.title: How to use Meta Business Suite as a Free CRM | CRM for Social Media
videos.description:
In this Meta Business Suite CRM tutorial, I share how you can use your Meta business suite as a free CRM.

The Meta business suite is an all-in-one social media management platform that allows you to manage your contacts, conversations, leads and customers funneling from your social media channels.

👉 Get started with Meta Business Suite here ➜
Business.facebook.com

My favourite Meta Business Suite CRM capabilities and features:

- Manage your customizable sales pipeline.
- Connect and manage Messenger, WhatsApp and Instagram conversations.
- Manage labels
- Setup follow-up reminders.
- Add important contact information and details.
- Capture new leads through forms.
- Manage all your social media leads and customers in one place.
